name: Dream Car Collection
creator: F Students = Inventors
redeem: Launch Dream Car Collection on Roblox and wait for your lot to load.
Click the small purple codes button in the bottom-right corner of the screen.
If you do not see it, open the Store and scroll to the codes field at the bottom instead.
Type or paste the code into the text box and press Redeem, then check the bottom of the screen for your reward.
notes:
Dream Car Collection is a car collecting tycoon from the F Students = Inventors group that went live on Roblox in August 2026 and is still labelled as a beta. You spawn lucky crates, buy them, then place and open them to reveal a car. Cars added to your collection earn money over time, even while you are offline, and that money funds pricier crates on the way to rarer cars. Races with friends, car cleaning and car edits add variety.

Codes here mostly give potions, such as crate luck potions and everything potions, plus the occasional batch of gems. Luck potions are best used right before opening a run of expensive crates. New codes are posted in the Discord codes channel and in the Roblox description.

faq.q: What does the LARP code give in Dream Car Collection, and when should I use it?
faq.a: LARP gives 3 Crate Luck Potions. Use them right before you open a run of expensive crates so the luck boost counts the most.

faq.q: I can't find the codes button in Dream Car Collection. Where is it?
faq.a: Once your lot has loaded, look for the small purple codes button in the bottom-right corner of the screen. If it isn't there, open the Store and scroll down to the codes field at the bottom.

faq.q: Where does the Dream Car Collection developer post new codes?
faq.a: New codes are posted in the codes channel of the game's Discord and in the game's Roblox description. The LARP code, for example, appears in the description.

tips: Add each new car to your collection as soon as you open it. Only collected cars earn money, so a car left sitting does nothing for your income.
Check in often. Money keeps building while you are offline, so coming back to spend it on new crates keeps your collection growing.
Races with friends are all or nothing, according to the game page. Be ready to walk away with nothing if you lose before you start one.
As your income grows, put it toward the better crates rather than lots of cheap ones. Pricier crates are the path to rarer cars.
useRewards: Crate Luck Potions only help while you are opening crates, so build up enough money to open several in a row before you drink one. Past codes have also given everything potions and gems, and gems are a separate currency worth keeping until you know what you want. The game is still in beta and changes often, so redeem LARP soon.
